import json
d=json.load(open(var_call_7))
P={p['_id']:p for p in d}
def comps(pn):
    return [b['component_number'] for b in P[pn].get('bom',[]) if b.get('end_date') in (None,'None')]
seen=set();stack=comps('BK-M68B-38');res=[]
while stack:
    c=stack.pop()
    if c in seen: continue
    seen.add(c)
    p=P.get(c)
    if p is None: res.append((c,'missing'));continue
    if str(p['make_flag'])=='0':
        lts=[int(v['average_lead_time']) for v in p.get('vendors',[])]
        res.append((c,max(lts) if lts else None, [v['vendor']['name'] for v in p.get('vendors',[])]))
    stack+=comps(c)
direct=[ (c,[v['average_lead_time'] for v in P[c].get('vendors',[])],P[c]['make_flag']) for c in comps('BK-M68B-38')]
print('__RESULT__:')
print(json.dumps({'res':res,'direct':direct}))
